detail.scriptResult: fail as run by scripts/migration/functional/run.mjs (logoutStatus 200, but the subsequent GET /api/admin/session with the harness's cached cookie value still returned isAdmin:true)
detail.rootCause: Harness bug, not an app defect: Assertions.request() records the session cookie once at login (captureSetCookie after F4) but the F9 test never re-captures/clears it after POST /api/admin/logout, so it keeps sending the pre-logout cookie value on the follow-up GET. iron-session is stateless (encrypted cookie, no server-side revocation list), so re-presenting the old, still-cryptographically-valid cookie after logout necessarily still decrypts to isAdmin:true.

independentVerification.logoutResponseSetCookie: growmax-admin=; Path=/; Max-Age=0; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=lax (correctly clears the cookie)

runHistory.causeOfF4F8Failure: Verifier procedural error: `source docs/migration/.scratch/.env.production` was run before the suite to obtain DST_URL, and this also set ADMIN_PASSWORD to that file's value. Sensitive-type Vercel env vars are redacted on `vercel env pull`, so that file's ADMIN_PASSWORD line is the literal string "[SENSITIVE]", not the real secret — the suite was testing the wrong password, not a real app/deploy defect. Confirmed by re-running with the container session's own (correct) ADMIN_PASSWORD value: F4-F8 all pass.
